column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST: one arm per registered backend, each calling backend.Setup which calls testutil.TestDB, so mysql and mssql skip in these PostgreSQL-only jobs while postgres RUNS -- two, not three. Measured by NAME rather than by delta, with CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL and CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL unset: go test ./engine/ -run TestPollChildTakesAnyRunInTheTenant -count=1 -json | grep "\"Action\":\"skip\"" reports exactly TestPollChildTakesAnyRunInTheTenant/mssql and /mysql, with /postgres passing. The arms have to exist even where they skip, because the contract under test is a property of the QUERY and the three dialects do not share one: GetChildResult is written out separately in engine/store_children.go, engine/mysql_store.go and engine/mssql_signals_promises.go, and a parentage predicate could be added to one without the others. This is the cleat#1120 contract -- poll_child takes any run id in the caller tenant, despite its name -- and a postgres-only run cannot vouch for the other two dialects any more than it could for their SQL.
